scenarios.title: acknowledgeMessages (4 named MethodSource rows)
scenarios.initialState: Persisted per-device messages; selected ACK holes.

scenarios.title: ackMessages; maxOutstandingAllowsGaps; duplicateAckIgnored
scenarios.initialState: Stream has more messages than the unacknowledged capacity.

scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: First unique ACK allows one further message; duplicate ACK allows no extra message or error; outstanding hole does not prevent other unique ACKs releasing credit.

implementedZoenSubset.verification: Integrated client-core library: 541 tests passed and strict all-target Clippy passed in the root-owned batch. implementedZoenSubset.verification: Root-operated isolated PostgreSQL16 and actual authenticated loopback WebSocket: original focused positive and restored positive each passed 1/1, zero failed/ignored, 13 filtered (test bodies 0.20s and 0.25s; wrappers 1.130s and 0.916s). The separate private spawn-detachment control failed with exit 101 at the intended closing-socket cancellation assertion before reconnect (test body 1.14s; wrapper 2.040s), with the normal production two-second lookup timeout unchanged. Strict Clippy for zoen-relay --test session_revocation with -D warnings passed 6.901446s; this is not all-target or full-suite qualification. Original and restored positives share exact production Session SHA 9f40fc5c and test executable SHA 96a0fa76, distinct from negative executable SHA 92151206. This source-only documentation update ran no compiler, service or test.
implementedZoenSubset.boundary: Original test-owned LogStore oneshot holds one actually polled co_members lookup. Close must retire it once after logical Hub offline, with the entire first-poll-to-Drop lifetime strictly below the own one-second fixture bound, separate from the unchanged production two-second lookup deadline. A late empty producer finds no receiver; the post-await continuation remains zero. Fresh signed reconnect requires Ready{registered:true}, Ping/Pong and local online state, while old Drop/continuation counts stay 1/0. This is Session-owned pending presence cancellation and authenticated replacement-session liveness; Ready/Pong do not establish catch-up or delivery. Hub::is_online proves logical offline in this non-revocation fixture, not generic structural removal of every revoked mailbox. No actual FDB availability watch, FDB network/server, NATS/multi-node presence, durable message delivery/order, MLS, whole-process restart, device behavior or full Signal parity is qualified. Heavy scheduling may fail the strict fixture; do not widen its bound toward the production timeout.

scenarios.introducedFault: Connection loss/recovery callbacks are injected; there is no actual network outage.
scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: Intermediate call and connection become ReconnectingAfterAccepted with no ended/error; final call returns ConnectedAndAccepted, exactly one Reconnected event, manager remains busy.
scenarios.sourceAssertionLimit: No acoustic continuity, real ICE/TURN path, roaming or reconnect deadline measurement is asserted.

scenarios.title: Drop and ICE failure conclude once regardless of order
scenarios.initialState: Connecting simulated incoming call.
scenarios.sequence: Drop directly; order hangup then drop; order ICE failure before/after app drop.
scenarios.introducedFault: Explicit local cancellation and selected remote/ICE failure callbacks are interleaved.
scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: Exactly one ended event, zero internal errors, manager no longer busy and all outgoing hangup counters zero. AppDroppedCall reason is specifically checked in direct drop and drop-before-ICE cases.
scenarios.sourceAssertionLimit: This is queue/state-machine conclusion behavior in simulation; it is not a proof that every native callback/device resource has been released.
scenarios.zoenEvidence: apps/zoen/src/components/chat-header.ios.tsx:34-35,45-48 disables voice/video actions; apps/zoen/acceptance.json retains ios-background-and-calls and encrypted-voice-video-calls journeys as pending. No dedicated call signaling operation/state was found in inspected crates/protocol/src/lib.rs or native ZoenCoreModule call-name search. Generic chat/ephemeral transport and audio-message playback do not establish calling behavior.
scenarios.adoptionBoundary: Make repeated local/remote termination idempotent. Stop all owned native resources and attribute one final outcome without echoing incompatible hangups.

scenarios.title: Notification failure cannot prevent media teardown
scenarios.initialState: Connected and accepted simulated outgoing call with peer-connection handle.
scenarios.sequence: Force call-ended notification failure, hang up, flush teardown work, then clear the forced failure.
scenarios.introducedFault: SimPlatform explicitly forces call-ended notification failure.
scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: Peer connection closed; outgoing audio disabled; RTP sink unregistered.
scenarios.sourceAssertionLimit: These are simulated resource flags, not native microphone/camera or OS callback observations. This test does not assert successful end-notification delivery.

No dedicated call signaling operation/state was found in inspected crates/protocol/src/lib.rs or native ZoenCoreModule call-name search. Generic chat/ephemeral transport and audio-message playback do not establish calling behavior.
scenarios.adoptionBoundary: Resource release must not depend on UI/listener success. Keep control teardown independent of best-effort notification.

adaptedZoenSubset.boundary: Three original tests use the real MessageAudioSession, AudioClipController and PlaybackCoordinator with existing synthetic native-player/file ports. Upstream Signal assertions were read; its suite was not executed and no source was copied.

scenarios.title: Termination works with saturated control queues
scenarios.initialState: Connected and accepted call; selected call/connection FSM can be paused.
scenarios.sequence: Pause FSM and fill bounded queue; request local hangup, or place remote hangup before saturation; resume and observe teardown/conclusion/worker termination.
scenarios.introducedFault: Controlled queue saturation plus withheld processing. Helper fill functions assert that admission eventually refuses, and wait_for_teardown flushes the separate hangup and teardown FIFO tasks.
scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: Peer connection closes, outgoing audio stops and RTP sink unregisters despite full queues. Local/remote conclusion counters are checked in relevant cases; dedicated call/connection tests prove FSM termination after resume even when Terminate could not be queued.
scenarios.sourceAssertionLimit: Five separate test bodies within this family, plus helpers, not one universal assertion. Resource-release checks are SimPlatform flags. No queue capacities or timeout constants should transfer.

No dedicated call signaling operation/state was found in inspected crates/protocol/src/lib.rs or native ZoenCoreModule call-name search. Generic chat/ephemeral transport and audio-message playback do not establish calling behavior.
scenarios.adoptionBoundary: Preserve an out-of-band idempotent cancellation/resource-stop path. A full data/event queue must not prevent hangup or require a successful final queued event.

scenarios.title: Expired call links retain a typed outcome
scenarios.initialState: Electron-facing RingRTC API test with intercepted HTTP callback.
scenarios.sequence: Peek a call link; verify requested GET target; supply HTTP404 with explicit expired reason.
scenarios.introducedFault: HTTP callback is deliberately answered with404 and an expired-reason body.
scenarios.expectedAssertedResult: Result is unsuccessful and errorStatusCode is EXPIRED_CALL_LINK rather than an empty successful call state.
scenarios.sourceAssertionLimit: Package test runner is electron-mocha renderer. HTTP is mocked through receivedHttpResponse; no live SFU, credentials, server deployment or native media was qualified.
